# cobolrt rule catalogue

<!-- generated by tests/tools/cobolrt_rules.py from docs/language_status/cobolrt_rules.json; do not edit -->

Every semantic rule of the det-port Java runtime (gitgalaxy/tools/cobol_to_java/det/cobolrt, #4711): a stable ID, the IBM reference it implements, the options it depends on (#4704), its oracle-assumptions register entries (docs/language_status/register/) and its calibration (#4702). Each rule's code site carries `[rule ID]`; tests/cobol_mainframe/test_cobolrt_rules.py checks both directions.

Status, against IBM (the reference; GnuCOBOL is the instrument): MATCHED -- the runtime implements IBM's documented rule; DIFFERS -- it follows the oracle where z/OS differs or where IBM documents no result and the oracle's answer is modelled (declared in the register); ASSUMED -- IBM leaves it open or the runtime's reading of IBM is not yet confirmed, the choice named; REFUSED -- the runtime stops by name. Calibration: uncalibrated until a z/OS measurement backs the rule (#4702).

## IBM documents

- `cobol-lr`: IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 Language Reference, SC27-8713-03
- `cobol-pg`: IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 Programming Guide, SC27-8714-03
- `zarch-pop`: IBM z/Architecture Principles of Operation, SA22-7832
- `cics-apr`: IBM CICS Transaction Server for z/OS, Application Programming Reference (CICS command summary)
- `db2-sql`: IBM Db2 for z/OS SQL Reference
- `db2-codes`: IBM Db2 for z/OS Codes
- `db2-app`: IBM Db2 for z/OS Application Programming and SQL Guide
- `le-pr`: IBM z/OS Language Environment Programming Reference
- `carddemo-mvswait`: CardDemo app/asm/MVSWAIT.asm -- the estate's own assembler routine (no IBM manual applies; the source is the reference)
- `carddemo-cobdatft`: CardDemo app/asm/COBDATFT.asm -- the estate's own assembler routine (no IBM manual applies; the source is the reference)
- `ims-apis`: IBM IMS Application Programming APIs (DL/I calls, SSAs, relational operators)
- `ims-ap`: IBM IMS Application Programming (DB PCB masks, current position in the database)
- `ims-codes`: IBM IMS Messages and Codes, Volume 4: IMS Component Codes (DL/I status codes)
- `mvs-da`: IBM z/OS MVS Data Areas (PSA, TCB, TIOT)

## Options

- `TRUNC` (compile): TRUNC(STD | OPT | BIN): binary items and the PICTURE
- `NUMPROC` (compile): NUMPROC(NOPFD | PFD): preferred signs
- `ARITH` (compile): ARITH(COMPAT | EXTEND): intermediate precision, NUMVAL's float
- `INTDATE` (compile): INTDATE(ANSI | LILIAN): day 1 of the integer-date functions
- `ZONEDATA` (compile): ZONEDATA(PFD | MIG | NOPFD): zone bits of zoned data
- `QUOTE` (compile): QUOTE | APOST: the figurative constant QUOTE
- `ARITHMETIC-OSVS` (dialect): OS/VS COBOL arithmetic, decided by the translator (det/osvs.py; cobc arithmetic-osvs)
- `DECIMAL-POINT-COMMA` (source): SPECIAL-NAMES DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA
- `CURRENCY-SIGN` (source): SPECIAL-NAMES CURRENCY SIGN and PICTURE SYMBOL
- `PROGRAM-COLLATING-SEQUENCE` (source): OBJECT-COMPUTER PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE, a SORT / MERGE COLLATING SEQUENCE
- `REGION-CODE-PAGE` (deployment): the CICS region's code page (the estate's EBCDIC page, else CCSID 037)

| RT-DLI-GET | GU / GN / GNP and their holds: the first segment in hierarchic sequence satisfying the SSAs, from the database's start, from position, or under parentage; GE / GB / GP / GA / GK; position and parentage after the call; command code D hands back the D-coded segments before the found one | `ims-apis` GU / GHU, GN / GHN, GNP / GHNP calls | - | I1 (ASSUMED); I3 (ASSUMED) | ASSUMED | uncalibrated |
